verdict.rationale: The pack documents no S3-compatible endpoint, no cloud-storage sync, and no dedicated data-transfer tooling for moving data in and out. What it does show is adjacent only: shared drives are internal storage reachable from machines on a private network, plus 'free unlimited bandwidth', SSH root access and a bare doc title about mounting datasets in notebooks. None of these describes a transfer mechanism, and one community report says copying datasets onto Core servers was very slow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can move data in and out efficiently — S3-compatible endpoints, cloud-storage sync, or documented transfer tooling
